title: A fun and unique dinner experience in Barcelona!
text: Chris guided us through cooking a delicious traditional Spanish dinner… complete with sangria, seafood paella and crema Catalan. He was friendly, knowledgeable and patient with our entire family. It was the perfect way to round out our trip to Barcelona and our kids loved getting involved in the kitchen. The food was delicious! We would recommend this class to any group looking for a personalized and unique dinner experience.
author: 818michellej

title: Awesome!
text: Josh is a really excellent teacher, his cooking studio is SO cool and beautiful, and it was so much fun to learn not only how to make the paella, but a proper sangria as well! I would highly recommend this activity to anyone interested in cooking and learning something new.
author: Kristi O
